title: 因幡の白兎 (The White Rabbit of Inaba)
description: A white rabbit lives on an island and wants to cross the sea to the mainland. It tricks a row of sharks into lining up to be counted, then hops across their backs — but boasts at the end and is skinned by the last angry shark. Eighty cruel princes pass and give the rabbit false advice. Only the kind-hearted Okuninushi (大国主命) gives true healing. One of Japan's oldest myths, from the 古事記 (Kojiki, 712 AD), the earliest surviving Japanese chronicle.
author: 古事記 (Kojiki, 712 AD) — compiled by 太安万侶 (Ō no Yasumaro)
